searchText: Hi Jimmy, can you also please guide how can i get the **SignedBeaconBlock blob** through the beacon node API? i need it for configuring a manual checkpoint sync (https://lighthouse-book.sigmaprime.io/checkpoint-sync.html#manual-checkpoint-sync) Dumb question here: are releases to Electra being cut out of the develop branch? I want to know if I look at the latest develop branch that this one will always be a descendant of the latest release or not In particular, is it the case right now? I am asking specifically cause `consolidations` was there in the `BeaconBlockBody` and they aren't there anymore. cc <@415109946682769408> you are the one cutting releases right? Ah they moved to the payload 😦 this changes my ePBS branch a bit `dev` branch is the latest Electra specs. We merge `dev` into `master` branch every time we are cutting new releases. yeah... I think Electra is getting stable now. But if you want to make sure there is no *any* interference from Electra R&D, you can rebase the new feature to after Deneb. Thanks, I'll open the EIP on top of Electra I think, anyway Max EB is kinda needed for ePBS. I just wanted to make sure I got the latest. My last version had `consolidations` in the body, checking now if these changes change a bit how to deal with block processing

excerpts.content: `dev` branch is the latest Electra specs. We merge `dev` into `master` branch every time we are cutting new releases.

excerpts.content: yeah... I think Electra is getting stable now. But if you want to make sure there is no *any* interference from Electra R&D, you can rebase the new feature to after Deneb.
